correction: The PARTIAL classification and its evidence hold. The auditor missed two places where the finding's problem still exists. (1) Agent Control's ryco_list_workspaces (apps/server/src/agentControl/workspaceLifecycle.ts:309-320, inspect at :269-279) calls inspectCheckout for each workspace without projectFacts or caches, at concurrency 2. Each workspace therefore still runs inspectProjectGitFacts: common-dir, rev-parse HEAD, worktree list --porcelain and for-each-ref refs/heads, which is 4 project-level spawns per workspace. That is the original pattern, for up to 50 workspaces per page. (2) In the settings-view ProjectWorkspacesSection (suggestionsEnabled: suggestionsCapability.allowed at ProjectWorkspacesSection.tsx:428), the client waits for listWorkspaces and lifecycle.suggestions together (useProjectWorkspaceInspection.ts:60-82, Promise.allSettled). The list cannot render until suggestions finishes, and suggestions runs loadContext('all'): a full shell snapshot, listTrashed(10000), and up to 20 inspections across all projects at concurrency 2. The map view passes suggestionsEnabled: false (useProjectMapCheckouts.tsx:163), so it is not gated. I also confirmed the auditor's status-staleness note with a real git worktree. In-place edits to tracked files (root or nested) and a new untracked directory under src/ left every fingerprint component unchanged: dir ino/mtime, .git link stat, gitdir HEAD and index stats.
decisionReason: The recommended remaining steps need no decision: un-gate the web list from suggestions, batch the unmerged check, hoist project facts in Agent Control list, and short-circuit removed rows. Two options would need owner sign-off if pursued. The first is deriving per-checkout HEAD, branch and common-dir from worktree list or link files instead of running git inside the checkout, which reduces listing-level verification depth (a behaviour trade-off; preview and apply stay from scratch). The second is a new streaming listWorkspaces RPC, which would also need a hosted capability entry.
summary: PR #710 (60633eff3), with follow-ups 502adfd1e and 46f0f6cd0, implemented proposal parts 1 and 3 for the Projects page. inspectProjectGitFacts reads common-dir, root HEAD, worktree list and every branch head once per list() or suggestions() call. A 30 s stat-fingerprint read cache (single-flight via Effect.cachedWithTTL) and a 10 min ancestry cache are shared by list() and suggestions(). Preview and apply deliberately inspect from scratch. Removed rows skip worktree-level git implicitly (the directory is missing), and list's loadContext is project-scoped. Still open: (a) a cold listing runs 4 spawns per live worktree (rev-parse HEAD, status, symbolic-ref, common-dir) plus one rev-list per diverged branch (ahead/behind is not batched); (b) nothing is delivered progressively, and the settings-view workspace list waits for the slower suggestions call; (c) Agent Control's ryco_list_workspaces still repeats the 4 project-level spawns per workspace with no hoisting; (d) the status cache can show a dirty checkout as clean (or the reverse) for up to 30 s, because edits to file contents do not change the fingerprint. This affects display only, since preview and apply re-inspect.

evidence.note: inspectProjectGitFacts runs common-dir, rev-parse HEAD, worktree list --porcelain -z and for-each-ref refs/heads once. No ahead-behind or --no-merged batching.
Uses the precomputed facts when projectId matches. Without them (Agent Control, WorkspaceChangeSummary, preview) it recomputes all 4 project-level spawns.

CheckoutReadCache: 30 s TTL, single-flight via Effect.cachedWithTTL (semantics checked in node_modules/effect Effect.ts:14377), failures not kept, LRU capacity 1024. The ancestry cache has a 10 min TTL.

Fingerprint covers dir ino/mtime, .git link, gitdir HEAD and index stats, and branchHead. Reproduced in /tmp: in-place edits to root.txt and src/a.txt plus a new src/new/ untracked dir left all components unchanged while git status showed M, M, ??. Status can be stale for up to 30 s in listings.
Cold per-live-worktree spawns: rev-parse HEAD (:494), status (:498), symbolic-ref (:560), common-dir (:564-567). rev-list --count per diverged branch (:542-555), cached 10 min.
list(): project facts once, then inspectWorkspace with listingCaches at concurrency 4. Returns the whole array at once.
suggestions(): loadContext('all') (full shell snapshot plus listTrashed 10000 at :423-426), per-project facts via Effect.cached, shared listingCaches, concurrency 2.
Only main or null-path rows skip inspectCheckout. checkoutRemovedAt rows still go through overlap loops, policy checks and lstat, and through the rev-list when the branch survives.
loadState (preview, execute, applyCurrent) inspects without caches, so the stale listing status cannot cause unsafe removal.

Missed by the auditor. Agent Control list calls inspectCheckout per workspace (up to 50, concurrency 2) with no projectFacts, so it repeats the 4 project-level spawns per workspace, including removed rows.

Missed by the auditor. Promise.allSettled([listWorkspaces, suggestions]) means the settings-view list renders only after suggestions finishes. Component-local state, so a remount starts from 'loading'.
The map view passes suggestionsEnabled: false, so the map is gated only on list().
lifecycle.listWorkspaces is unary with a Schema.Array result. No progressive or cheap-first delivery.

Project facts (4 spawns) are recomputed on every list() and suggestions() call, not single-flighted across concurrent calls (WorkspaceLifecycle.ts:575-583). This is small.
fixDefects: The status read cache's fingerprint (checkoutInspection.ts:259-270) does not capture worktree content. With GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0, status never refreshes the index, and in-place edits to tracked files anywhere, or new files or directories below the checkout root, change none of: dir ino/mtime, .git link, gitdir HEAD, index. Reproduced with a real worktree. list() and suggestions() can therefore show a dirty checkout as clean, with 'remove checkout' and suggestions enabled (or the reverse), for up to CHECKOUT_READ_TTL (30 s) after a previous listing. Safety is intact because preview, execute and applyCurrent re-inspect without caches (WorkspaceLifecycle.ts:900-913, 952, 1136). The 'previews always inspect from scratch' test writes at the checkout root and the cache test uses git add, so no test covers nested or in-place edits. The original proposal's key had the same blind spot.
implementationSketch: A. Web, smallest change with the most visible effect: in apps/web/src/components/projects/sections/useProjectWorkspaceInspection.ts, settle listWorkspaces as soon as it resolves and fill suggestions in when they arrive (two promises, or keep suggestions: null plus a suggestionsLoading flag), so the settings-view list no longer waits for loadContext('all') and the cross-project inspections. Optionally keep the last settled value in a module-level Map keyed by scopeKey, so a remount shows previous results with refreshing: true instead of 'loading'. Test: a browser or unit test where suggestions never resolves and summaries still render. B. Batch unmerged: in inspectProjectGitFacts (checkoutInspection.ts:366-376), after baseHead, run `git for-each-ref --no-merged=<baseHead> --format=%(refname) refs/heads` (git 2.7+, so no version fallback is needed; %(ahead-behind:) would need 2.41+) and store unmergedBranches: ReadonlySet<string> in ProjectGitFacts. In inspectCheckout (:542-555), when projectFacts came from the precomputed path, use unmerged = branchHead !== null && branchHead !== baseHead && unmergedBranches.has(branch). Keep the rev-list fallback when facts are read fresh. Test with WorkspaceLifecycle.test.ts gitCalls: a list() with N diverged branches issues no rev-list. C. Agent Control: in apps/server/src/agentControl/workspaceLifecycle.ts list (:309-320), compute inspectProjectGitFacts once (Effect.option, fall back to per-workspace reads on failure) and pass projectFacts into inspect/inspectCheckout. Do not pass the TTL caches, because revalidate compares a fresh read() with plan.expected via isDeepStrictEqual. read() and revalidate stay unchanged. Test: count git calls for a 3-workspace list and assert one worktree list. D. Removed rows: in WorkspaceLifecycle.inspectWorkspace (:513), when worktree.checkoutRemovedAt != null, skip inspectCheckout, or pass a flag so inspectCheckout only computes unmerged from projectFacts. Check that summarize/workspaceActionBlockers do not need facts for removed rows (the delete action may use unmerged; keep that field). E. Staleness (optional): fold a cheap content signal into the status fingerprint, for example the max mtime of the root's direct child directories plus root files (one readdir with stat, bounded), or cut the status TTL to about 5-10 s while keeping the HEAD, symbolic-ref and common-dir TTL at 30 s. Add a test that edits a nested tracked file in place and expects the next list() within the TTL to report modified > 0, or document the lag explicitly. F. Needs a decision, not recommended now: for listings only, derive HEAD and branch from the worktree list entry and validate common-dir via the already-read .git link, gitdir/commondir file reads, instead of running symbolic-ref, rev-parse HEAD and common-dir in the checkout. That leaves status as the only per-checkout spawn.
